bio: This charming country inn is located by the picturesque Krotensee, a stone's throw from the historic Hüttenstein Castle. In its lovely, rustic dining spaces, delicious Alpine-Adriatic cuisine is served: fresh oysters, fish and seafood, game and braised meat, as well as various steaks; whole fish from the Mondsee are served based on the daily catch. Order à la carte or opt for a set menu. The well-curated wine list is international but highlights Austrian producers. They also have well-appointed guestrooms for overnight guests.
